title: Coconut Milk Pulao
ingredients:
2 cup Jeera/Basmati rice(soak for 20 mins)
1 onion(sliced)
1 tomato(sliced)
1 inch ginger
5 cloves of garlic
 2 Green Chilli
10 mint leaves
10 coriander leaves
2.5 cup coconut milk
 1.5 cup water
1 tea spoon of Garam Masala
 Salt
 1 table spoon Ghee
1 table spoon Coconut oil
 Briyani items (Brinji leaves -1, Star anise -1, Cinnamon -1, Jeera seeds -1 tea spoon, Cardamon-3)
steps:
1. Take a Pressure Pan and add 1 table Spoon of Coconut Oil.
2. Add all briyani items one by one.
3. Saute the sliced onion.
4. Add sliced tomato.
5. Make ginger garlic + green chilli as a paste and add into the pan.
6. Add the mint and coriander leaves.
7. Saute the above items for 5 mins until the raw smell goes.
8. Add Coconut Milk and water as per the measurement.
9. Boil it for 2 mins.
10. Add necessary salt and Garam Masala at this stage.
11. Add the soaked Jeera/Basmati rice and boil it until it cooks around 50 to 60% and water levels down to the surface of rice.
12. Close the pressure pan and keep it the lower burner in the stove and put in SIM mode for 7 mins.
13. Turn Off the flame after 7mins and wait for another 5 minutes, then open the pressure pan and add 1 table spoon of ghee.
14. Delicious Pulao is ready to serve!.
Preferred Side dishes:
Honey Chilli Potato
Mushroom Pepper Fry
